reserveReview.rationale: Issuer factsheet dated October 31, 2026 reports commercial paper 46.5%, certificates of deposit 34.8%, time deposits 15.6% and cash 3.1% of total net assets, totalling 100.0% as published. It reports 38 positions, USD 26m whole-fund size, WAM 44 days and WAL 72 days, and a Class 1 ACC NAV of 101.68. These averages are not maximum tenor. The exact Class 1 ACC identity is FILQ-A, ISIN KYG3R61G1088; Class 1 DIST is a separate claim. The Moody's Aaa-mf fund assessment is explicitly not a credit rating. The same issuer factsheet endpoint now serves the October 31, 2026 edition (published 2026-11-19T16:19:26Z), superseding the September 30 edition reviewed on 2026-10-29. Direct PDF access returned 403; the issuer document was recovered through its text mirror on 2026-11-23T23:14:19Z. The whole-fund asset-class percentages are not a token-level FILQ-A asset/liability reconciliation and do not prove 1:1 backing; the October 31 portfolio date, not the mirror's HTTP timestamp or this review date, governs freshness.
